  PROBLEM: When a redirection follows `env -S` / `--split-string`, shape handling fails to consume the split-string command, allowing script-like command text containing credentials to remain verbatim.
  WHY: The resulting command shape can expose plaintext credentials in permission-prompt reports and GitHub issue text; severity was reported as MAJOR by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and BLOCKER by google_gemini-3_8-flash and openai_gpt-6-luna.

  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Parsing `env -S` split strings with POSIX `shlex` instead of GNU `env` split-string rules mis-tokenizes `\_` as an escaped underscore rather than a space, causing credential flags to go undetected.
  WHY: For `env -S 'mysql\_-pS3cretPass app'`, the scanner misses the password and can return the original command for posting; severity was reported as BLOCKER by openai_gpt-6-luna and NIT by z-ai_glm-5_2.
